final_response.answer: CS 2114 (3 credits): A programming-intensive exploration of software design concepts and implementation techniques. Builds on knowledge of fundamental object-oriented programming. Advanced object-oriented software design, ethics in computing, algorithm development and analysis, and classic data structures. Includes a team-based software project. By historical grade outcomes, Andrey Esakia is the strongest listed instructor: 3.24 average GPA and 49.8% A/A- rate across 229 students. Fall 2026 has 14 sections; 11 sections have open seats. Scheduled instructors include Sehrish Nizamani, DH Smith IV.
